scope: Authored application code, reconstructed geometry, interactive furnishings and source-analysis records. Original panoramas, developer render references, apartment plans and the office3/5 plan retain their source authors rights. Approximate 3D apartment contours, facade registration, furniture and household poses are authored reconstructions, not developer working drawings. Distributed geometry marks and existing texture signatures identify provenance but do not technically prevent copying. Geographic data remains © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL1.0.
